title: review follow-ups of PR #37582: milestone summary translation (token grammar spelled twice, per-row packaged-base walks, stale jsdoc, a template token added after rows were written)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review records 7196337094 and 7197635792 on PR #37582, accepted deviations and nits, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37582 (Fixes #37524) composes a fired milestone's activity summary in the reader's language from `objects.<o>._milestones.<field>.<value>.summary`. Its two reviews left these items open on `main` once it lands:

- [ ] **A template token added after rows were written leaves a gap.** The writer (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`) stores a token only when it interpolated a value. After an app adds a `{token}` to a milestone template, rows written before the edit are composed from the new translation with an empty hole, while their stored English sentence is whole. Expected: such a row falls back to its stored sentence (for example, by storing the template's token names, so the reader can tell a token that was never interpolated from an empty one).
- [ ] **The `{token}` grammar is spelled twice** (N3): `milestoneTokenRe()` in the writer, whose jsdoc says "One definition", and a literal `/\{(\w+)\}/g` in the composer (`activity-summary-message.ts`). Expected: one exported pattern.
- [ ] **Per-row packaged-base walks** (N4): `milestoneSummary` runs `getPackagedObjectBase` and two `milestoneOn` walks per row with no cache, while `translatedObjectDef` beside it caches per object for the read. Expected: a per-(object, field) cache for one read.
- [ ] **Stale jsdoc** (N6): two sentences in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` ("three scalars", "its two callers") no longer hold after the predicate's key union gained `summary`. The header comment at `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-option-label-summary.test.ts:29` still says a milestone sentence "has no bundle key and is deliberately NOT translated (#7290)".

Category ①: the first item is a user-visible sentence with a hole; the others are the review's accepted deviations, carried here per the one-card-per-PR rule.
Priority: p3. The gap needs an app to edit a template after rows exist, and the stored English stays whole; the rest is code hygiene.
Business reason: a non-English reader of an activity timeline sees a milestone line with a blank where the English line has a value, after an app author edits the template.
Reader: the ux i18n area (seat 2, s2-ux-T), or the area that next touches plugin-audit's activity summaries.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37582"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37524, PR #37582, #37585 (skills follow-up of the same PR).

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (writer and composer at `4a22422916`) · evidence: read → p3
